name: create_change_set
purpose: Creates a draft change set: a snapshot of the live working-scope delta (default) or an immutable requirement proposal (additions copied from existing source requirements, or description revisions).
useWhen: Proposing requirement additions or description rewrites for owner review WITHOUT editing live requirements (requirementProposal mode)
Working scope has unpublished changes that must go to review and you are not using create_project_change_set_from_resolution
avoidWhen: Live-scope snapshot - prefer create_project_change_set_from_resolution (same result, returns changeSetId as JSON)
No delta (get_project_scope_resolution_context.workingScope.affectedCount = 0) - no change set needed
Discussion still open - use create_governance_thread or draft_change_set_from_governance_thread first

inputs.notes: what changes and why; include deletions (the delta cannot detect removals)

inputs.source: list_requirement_baselines -> id of the isCurrent baseline
inputs.notes: live mode: OMIT (another id breaks publication-gate matching); proposal mode: REQUIRED and must equal the current baseline id

either {additions:[{key [A-Za-z0-9_-], title<=300, description<=20000, type functional|non-functional|interface|business|technical, source:{projectId, baselineId, requirementId}, linkedIssueIds<=50}] (1-200)} or {revisions:[{requirementId, title (exact current), beforeDescription (exact current), description (new)}] (1-200)}; never mix; unknown keys rejected
proposal mode: send true first to get the fingerprint; nothing is written

preconditions: Live mode: caller can read the project
Proposal mode: caller can manage the project and read every source project; the project has exactly one current baseline
Proposal sources exist, are not deleted and belong to source.baselineId; linkedIssueIds are non-deleted issues of this project
returns: Live mode: plain text 'Change set created with ID: <id>'. Proposal dryRun: JSON {previewOnly:true, draft{reviewPolicy, workingScopeSnapshot, scopeProposal{contentFingerprint, ...}}}. Proposal create: JSON {id:'proposal-<fingerprint>', reused:false|true}.

errors.when: Preview and confirm the exact proposal fingerprint before creation
errors.fix: Call with dryRun:true, copy draft.scopeProposal.contentFingerprint into expectedProposalFingerprint and call again without dryRun.

errors.when: Proposal requires the unique current baseline of this project
errors.fix: Pass sourceBaselineId = id of the isCurrent baseline; if none or several are current, report to the owner.

errors.when: Source requirement or baseline mismatch
errors.fix: source.baselineId must be the baselineId of that source requirement; read it with list_requirements.

errors.when: Revision base text changed / Revision must change the description / Revision requirement is outside the current baseline
errors.fix: Re-read the requirement from the current baseline; title and beforeDescription must match exactly and description must differ.

errors.when: Linked issue outside project or missing / Duplicate proposal key / Duplicate source requirement
errors.fix: Fix the payload: issues of this project only, unique keys, each source once.

errors.when: Zod validation error (invalid_type, too_big, unrecognized_keys)
errors.fix: Fix the requirementProposal shape: additions OR revisions, allowed keys only, limits respected.

errors.when: You do not have permission to manage this project
errors.fix: Proposal mode needs manage access; ask the owner.

errors.when: Proposal exceeds safe document size / Project not found or archived
errors.fix: Split the proposal into smaller ones / verify projectId.

errors.when: -32003 (tool not allowed for this API key/connection, or 'The requested resource is outside the credential scope')
errors.fix: Call get_mcp_connection_info. This tool is not exposed to OAuth connectors; use an API key or agent credential whose profile includes it, on a project of the credential's workspace.

gotchas.text: Live mode freezes the delta now; editing requirements afterwards makes an approved change set stale and it will not unblock publication.
Proposal mode never edits live requirements, always needs formal review (draft->in-review->approved) and is retry-safe (same content -> same id, reused:true).
Additions must copy an existing source requirement - there is no free-text new-requirement proposal.
